Use case: illustration-story. A 2-column by 2-row art atlas of four equal full-bleed portrait 2:3 illustrations, overall 4:6 portrait. Production original fantasy card illustrations for Tavern Brawl, no frames, text, numbers, UI or gutters. Top left: Funeral Velvet, a raven priestess's flowing dark purple cloak threaded with ghostly violet souls in a moonlit stone chapel. Top right: black iron buckler struck by a shard of blue magic in a dark tavern. Bottom left: a glowing ancient bronze bell with flowing purple ghost light in a midnight tower. Bottom right: radiant golden lucky coin on a fox's black glove against dark blue background. Beautiful detailed painterly collectible card art, cinematic moonlight, deep black-blue shadows, selective amber and violet, strong readable foreground objects.
